title: Mountain's Toe Gold Mine

location.name: Mountain's Toe Gold Mine
location.description: A working gold mine on the lower slopes of Icespire Peak, now silent. Orcs overran the miners — but the mine sits in Cryovain's shadow, and the dragon itself sometimes visits, scouring the entrance with frost. A festering ochre jelly clogs one of the lower shafts.
location.environment: mine, mountain slope, cold, dungeon shafts

read_aloud: The Mountain's Toe mine gapes in the slope of Icespire Peak, its ore carts overturned, its winch-house cold. Orc sign is everywhere — but so is something else: long gouges raked into the frozen rock beside the entrance, and a rime of unnatural frost. Whatever holds this mine, the dragon has been here too.

enemies.special: Aggressive; a leader tries to collapse a shaft prop to split the party.

encounters.tactics: Orcs fight from the mine buildings and shafts, using carts and props. If losing, one may flee deeper toward the jelly's shaft (bad idea for it).
encounters.description: Orc occupiers of the mine surface works.

encounters.trigger_condition: party descends into the lower shafts

enemies.position: oozing through a flooded lower gallery
enemies.special: Splits on slashing/lightning. Blocks the richest ore vein and a small cache.

encounters.tactics: Slow corrosive hazard guarding the deep ore. Fire/bludgeoning avoids the split. Optional — a party can grab surface loot and leave.
encounters.description: The ochre jelly in the flooded shaft.

encounters.trigger_condition: OPTIONAL — the party is loud/uses fire at the exposed entrance and rolls poorly on the dragon-check

enemies.position: swooping the entrance for a single Cold Breath pass
enemies.special: Cryovain — do NOT run the full boss here. One flyby (Cold Breath 30-ft cone, DC 15) then it wheels back toward Icespire. A DEADLY warning, not the finale.

encounters.tactics: This is FORESHADOW only: if triggered, Cryovain makes one breath pass and leaves. It establishes the dragon's power and territory. The real fight is Chapter 5.
encounters.description: Optional Cryovain flyby — a scare, not a kill.

loot.location: the mine's strongbox + raw gold ore in the deep vein
an orc shaman's satchel, Investigation DC 12

skill_checks.success: Notice Cryovain's approach in time to take cover before its breath pass (avoid the flyby encounter).
skill_checks.failure: Caught in the open if the dragon comes.

skill_checks.success: Locate the mine's hidden strongbox and the richest ore vein.

dm_notes: SCALING (6 PCs, +50%): 7 orcs + the jelly. The Cryovain flyby is OPTIONAL foreshadowing — use it to build dread and teach the party to respect the dragon before Chapter 5. Never run the full dragon here. 3+ interactables: ore carts (cover/ram down the rails), shaft props (collapse to block/trap), the winch (raise/lower to reach shafts or drop a load).
